name: Bug-class variant sweep with a mandatory detector control
description: Once ONE instance of a bug class is confirmed, find every other instance of the same class instead of fixing the first symptom. The load-bearing stage is not the search: it is the DETECTOR CONTROL that proves the pattern finds the already-known instance. A pattern that cannot find the instance you already have makes its zero results mean nothing, and a zero-result sweep read as 'clean' is how a class fix becomes a point fix. The unit of done is the remediation SET, not the first file.

confirmed_defect_anchor.description: file:line of the ALREADY-CONFIRMED instance; this is the control target

class_pattern.description: Seed pattern (semgrep rule or regex); the sweep narrows it if noisy

search_scope.description: Root of the sweep; state it, because a narrow scope is how a sweep under-reports

max_hits_for_manual_triage.description: Above this the pattern is too noisy to triage and must be narrowed, never hand-walked

graduate_to_ci.description: Promote the validated pattern to a standing CI rule (owner decision)

pattern-author.description: Generalises the confirmed defect into a machine-checkable pattern

hit-triager.description: Decides per hit whether it is the SAME class; over-broad patterns die here

remediation-owner.description: Assembles the remediation set and its ordering

owner.description: The human owner - the only role that may turn a sweep pattern into a blocking CI gate

remediation-set-is-the-unit.expression: instances_confirmed_same_class > 0 AND remediation_set_size >= instances_confirmed_same_class AND single_file_declared_done == false

stages.title: Turn the confirmed defect into a machine-checkable pattern

work_unit.title: Generalise one confirmed defect into a pattern that names the class, not the instance
work_unit.question_or_target: Write a semgrep rule or AST query that expresses the DEFECT CLASS of the confirmed instance - not its identifiers, not its file. State explicitly what the pattern deliberately does NOT match, so the precision control has something falsifiable to check.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: pattern authoring is the skill this blueprint is bottlenecked on

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the pattern text, the confirmed instance it generalises, and an explicit near-miss construct the pattern must NOT match
tests_required: the pattern must match the confirmed instance named in confirmed_defect_anchor
both-states control: the declared near-miss construct must NOT match, or the pattern is too broad
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the detector-control gate is mechanical and runs before any sweep result is believed
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5201 emitted only when the pattern matches the known instance and does not match the declared near-miss construct; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5201 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot: narrow by AST shape instead of by token regex
work_unit.mechanism: generalisation of one instance into a class pattern with a declared near-miss

stages.title: The pattern MUST find the instance we already have
Narrow until triage is affordable, without losing the known instance
A near-miss construct must not be flagged, and triage must be affordable
Run the validated pattern over the declared scope
Per hit: same class, or not
The remediation SET is the unit of done

work_unit.title: Assemble the whole remediation set for the class, with its ordering and its scope caveat
work_unit.question_or_target: Emit every confirmed same-class instance as ONE remediation set, ordered so no fix depends on an unfixed sibling, and state the SCOPE the sweep actually covered - a set is only as complete as the scope it searched.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: set assembly and ordering is judgement, not a mechanical concatenation

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every instance cites file:line, the pattern that found it and the triage verdict; the searched scope is stated verbatim
tests_required: take a past confirmed defect, run the sweep, and count instances the ORIGINAL point fix missed
both-states control: shrink search_scope to one directory and assert the set shrinks and the scope caveat changes with it
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent reviewer re-runs the pattern over the same scope and compares set membership
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:CRV-5202 emitted only when the set contains every triaged same-class instance, is ordered, and names the exact scope searched; otherwise FAILED:CRV-5202 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to emitting the set as PARTIAL with the unsearched scope named
work_unit.mechanism: set assembly over triaged hits with an explicit scope declaration
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: a secret-exposure blast radius traces one credential across commits and consumers; this traces one CODE PATTERN across files

stages.title: Refuse a one-file done claim on a multi-instance class
Owner decision: promote this pattern to a standing CI gate?
stages.prompt: This pattern is validated against a known instance and a declared near-miss. Promote it to a standing CI rule? A blocking gate has an owner and a maintenance cost; a non-blocking one decays into noise. Choose deliberately.

impact.blast_radius: read-only sweep; writes a pattern, a triage file and a remediation set under command-center/review/**

x_extensions.licence_obligation: variant-analysis is CC BY-SA 4.0 (Trail of Bits); attribution recorded in lineage.derived_from. The MERGE adds the S1 detector control and the graduate-to-CI owner checkpoint, neither of which the source pack has.
x_extensions.mechanism: Derive a pattern from ONE confirmed instance, prove the pattern finds that instance, then search a declared scope and triage. The control precedes the search, so a zero result is interpretable.
contraindications: NOT before the first instance is CONFIRMED - pattern-hunting a hypothesis wastes a sweep
NOT when the class is too generic to express as a pattern - the precision control will refuse it
NOT a hand-walk: above max_hits_for_manual_triage the pattern is narrowed, never triaged by hand

benchmark_cases.name: known-instance-control
benchmark_cases.setup: the confirmed instance named in confirmed_defect_anchor
benchmark_cases.expected: the pattern finds it; if not, the sweep is aborted and its zero results are meaningless

benchmark_cases.name: near-miss-precision
benchmark_cases.setup: a deliberately similar but correct construct
benchmark_cases.expected: NOT flagged; a flag here means the pattern is too broad

x_extensions.why_not_a_duplicate: BP-SEC-02 traces the blast radius of a SECRET across commits and consumers; this traces a CODE PATTERN across files. BP-TST-07 also does set membership over a tree, but its assertion is FIXED (declared event in the EVENTS tuple) and its output is a pass/fail reachability report, whereas this derives a NEW pattern per incident and outputs a remediation set.
x_extensions.unverified: UNVERIFIED (very-likely the mechanism, unmeasured the yield) how many instances past point fixes missed on this estate; settling experiment = replay a past confirmed defect through this sweep and count instances the original fix left behind.
x_extensions.owner_decision: graduate_to_ci: promote a validated pattern to a blocking CI rule, an advisory one, or keep it a one-off sweep. The workflow deliberately cannot decide this - a blocking gate needs an owner and a maintenance budget.

worked_example.name: sweep the ensure_within path-containment class after one confirmed bypass
worked_example.narrative: Round 1 of the narrowing loop returned 431 hits (over budget) because the seed pattern matched every startswith. Round 2 required a path-typed receiver and returned 37, still matching the known instance. Triage confirmed 6 same-class instances; the near-miss (a startswith on a URL scheme) was correctly not flagged. The remediation set is 6 files, not the 1 the original fix touched.

negative_control.why: the whole blueprint rests on this: a pattern that misses the instance we already have must abort the sweep rather than report a clean tree
